reasons.A: Long, smoothly joined explanatory sentences, semicolons and a polished essayistic, generalising tone; nothing like the author's clipped, plain fragments.
reasons.B: Short plain sentences and fragments fit well, but the rhetorical 'Why bother...? Because... Because...' triad and the staged closing scene add a flourish the author never uses.
reasons.C: Closest movement: terse declaratives, fragment lists, 'Then' sequencing, no contractions, plain understated stance and a flat, quiet close, without overdoing the habits.
